content: {"episode_id":"ep-05161","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry) was ordered for a patient with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1). Given the documented history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9), prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with these neurological symptoms and dizziness (R42). The monitoring service is therefore medically necessary to establish the rhythm diagnosis underlying the patient's symptoms, and we request reconsideration of the PR-204 denial."}
